Name: Pet Mayonnaise Jar
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
This mod offers you an amazing opportunity: to have your very own mayonnaise jar pet!

Thanks to Alternative Textures, you can turn your cat or your dog into a mayonnaise jar pet.


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/699981232758325312/1018933806289399968/requirements.png[/img]﻿
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1050895834440540301/1122184287857430609/MCUBanner.png[/img]The MCU is a growing galaxy of unhinged mods with one common theme: Mayonnaise. This idea came to life after the release of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17122]The Unhinged Mayo Expansion[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/167786198]jayjaydub911[/url]. The great minds of the MCU gather on the [url=https://discord.gg/v9K3fkpWGz]Krobus Discord Server[/url]: a community for new and veteran Stardew Valley mod makers to
collaborate, share, and learn from each other in the mod-making journey.
Join us!
